purpose: Avoid wasting response time on expired, redirected, reposted or non-actionable job links and prefer the canonical application path.

rules.when: verified canonical company/job-board detail is active and exposes a valid application path
job detail is active but application action/contact cannot be verified
aggregator or repost is active but canonical source is missing/unknown
rules.restriction: must not become APPLY-FIRST solely from mirror evidence

rules.when: canonical source states closed, expired, no longer accepting applications, 404/410, or equivalent terminal state
application URL redirects to a different role/company or generic careers homepage without the original vacancy
